For many people, the ritual of applying makeup isn’t just about appearance; it’s a form of self-expression, creativity, and even self-care. The focus and care you put into blending foundation or perfecting eyeliner can be meditative, giving you a few minutes to yourself before the day’s demands take over.

It’s great that you’ve found a practice that makes you feel put-together and ready to face the world. Everyone’s morning routine looks different, and what matters most is that it works for *you*—supporting your well-being and setting you up for a good day.
